officialNormativeSources.licensing: No republication of the PDF in Git; use its concepts and locations for original review.

referenceFromUserPDF.subject: Conformance
referenceFromUserPDF.observation: EMOF and CMOF are separate conformance points; technology mapping must also be considered.

referenceFromUserPDF.subject: Meta layers
referenceFromUserPDF.observation: The MOF language supports at least two levels; project's four-level convention is optional.

referenceFromUserPDF.subject: Reflection
referenceFromUserPDF.observation: Metaobject reflection/element class and reflective operations.

referenceFromUserPDF.subject: Identifiers
referenceFromUserPDF.observation: Stable identities/extent and URI-based object identification.

referenceFromUserPDF.subject: Essential MOF
referenceFromUserPDF.observation: Simple metamodel profile; mappings to XMI or Java supported in principle.

referenceFromUserPDF.subject: EMOF constraints
referenceFromUserPDF.observation: Named type/property requirements, reflection and EMOF-specific constraints.

referenceFromUserPDF.subject: CMOF constraints
referenceFromUserPDF.observation: Additional CMOF model constraints; not automatic requirements for EMOF.

referenceFromUserPDF.subject: CMOF abstract semantics
referenceFromUserPDF.observation: CMOF-level abstract semantics; optional for EMOF according to the 2006 specification.

eclipseEMF.qualification: EMF Ecore is MOF-like and interoperates with EMOF serializations; not identical to EMOF.

enterpriseArchitect.qualification: No new licensing or dependency proposed.

qvtAtl.requirement: Must have approved, version-pinned M2 input/output definitions and independent tests.

xmi.requirement: Use current OMG XMI mapping and deterministic import/export equivalence tests if enabled.

chosenApproach.validationCompiler: Existing JSON Schema and project-specific deterministic checkers first; optional SHACL/OCL/XMI only when evidence supports them.

projectMetalevelConvention.meaning: Governed CKO domain metamodel packages, classes, fields, relations and policy bindings
projectMetalevelConvention.mapping: Existing metadata framework/profile/field registries and ce_platform object types; reconcile, do not duplicate

projectMetalevelConvention.meaning: Canonical source models for pages, tools, policies, agents, process and contracts
projectMetalevelConvention.mapping: Existing object model/registry and source models

projectMetalevelConvention.meaning: Business/clinical content instances, source evidence, execution records
projectMetalevelConvention.mapping: Existing source tables and instance rows with provenance

chosenApproach.metalevelCaveat: Four levels are an architecture convention of the project, NOT a rigid limit required by OMG MOF 2.0.

requiredIndependentEvidence: EMOF-specific metaclass and property conformance checks
Identifier and stable URI mapping across Git and Supabase
No cyclic containment or unsupported reflective mutation
Class/property naming constraints and cardinality checks
M3 schema validates actual M2 instance models and negative fixtures
M2-to-M1 generation and M1-to-M0 evidence lineage
If CMOF enabled, CMOF-specific constraints and extension semantics
If XMI enabled, official mapping/import-export equivalence and schema/version pinning
No unapproved copyrighted norm binaries in Git
Full source-branch reconciliation, Kernel admission and human release authority

knownFindings.detail: Existing CKO M3 grammars are project-generated; cannot assert OMG MOF conformance.
No independent EMOF/CMOF OCL or official XMI cross-model behavior test proven.
M3/M2 bindings, IDs and actual M2 instances require canonical semantic reconciliation.
Physical DB and 36 branch reconciliation / release process not homologated end-to-end.
